AN AGENT-SIDE FIELD REPORT FROM AN UNRELATED PROJECT, 2026-08-11, RECORDED REDACTED ON ANTHONY'S INSTRUCTION — no project name, no design counts, no domain terms. Written by a coding agent that had driven reflow2 through capture, where-am-i readbacks, gap review and acknowledgement, verification recording, and a server upgrade mid-project. Recorded as a fact rather than as proposals because that is what it IS: measured evidence about how reflow2 behaves in someone else's hands, which is the input class dec:idea-field-evidence-is-a-prioritisation-input asks whether to read.

=== SORTED THE WAY ANTHONY ASKED: CONFIRMS-ACCEPTED-INTENT vs NEW PROPOSAL vs ALREADY SATISFIED ===

CONFIRMS ACCEPTED INTENT (the report did not propose these; it independently showed they matter):

1. THE SPAWN ERROR NEVER NAMES THE FILE IT COULD NOT FIND. Confirms fact:defect-rebuild-strands-the-shared-server (measured here 2026-08-07, fix named in its own evidence field, filed and left unfixed). INDEPENDENT AND SIMULTANEOUS: the same defect blocked a session in this repo on 2026-08-11 for forty minutes. FIXED the same day; their narrower ask — name the path — is in that fix.

2. RE-RUNNING A VERIFICATION IS MORE CEREMONY THAN THE EVENT DESERVES. A recorded check re-ran green twice and last_run_at was left stale, honestly, because updating an unchanged status felt like paperwork. Confirms req:verification-keeps-up (ACCEPTED: "a 'verified' claim says how old the check behind it is"). Their sentence is the sharp part and is not in this graph anywhere: STALE LAST-RUN UNDERMINES ASSURANCE MORE THAN A MISSING VERIFICATION DOES, BECAUSE IT LOOKS CURRENT. An accepted requirement is being defeated by friction rather than by absence.

3. THE QUESTION LEDGER CANNOT SEE THE MOST NATURAL WAY QUESTIONS GET ASKED. The where-am-i skill instructs the agent to put open gaps to the user as prose; doing so leaves open_questions at zero and the loop still reporting the gaps as never asked, because only the gap_to_prompt handshake registers an ask. Confirms the ledger's own purpose (questions outlive sessions, in the wording the user saw, so nobody is re-asked) and reveals a SERVED SKILL BYPASSING IT. Their framing: the debt list nags about work that was done.

4. A SATISFYING CAPABILITY IN ANOTHER GRAPH FORCES A PERMANENT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT. A program deliberately running several graphs found on day one that SATISFIES/REALIZES cannot point across a design boundary, so gaps that are structurally answered stay open forever as acknowledgements. Confirms req:design-composes and req:complementary-pairing (both accepted) and sharpens dec:idea-how-is-a-source-outside-the-repo-registered, recorded here hours earlier from the ARTIFACT side of the identical shape: a reference that cannot leave its own design's boundary.

NEW PROPOSALS (nothing in the graph asks for these):

5. AN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT CANNOT STATE A MACHINE-CHECKABLE RE-REVIEW TRIGGER. Several acknowledgements carried explicit retirement conditions in prose; one had been true for weeks and nothing surfaced it. NARROWER THAN THEY WROTE, and the narrowing matters: expiry machinery EXISTS and recomputes from the affected node set, so this is not "acknowledgements never expire" — it is that they cannot express a CONDITION. Their words: acknowledgements are where gaps go to be forgotten safely, and the safety decays silently.

6. THE LOOP ONLY SEES WHAT AN AGENT HAND-CARRIES IN. Their own synthesis and the strongest thing in the report: the liveliest facts of the month — merged PRs, a review round addressed, a suite re-verified, work scheduled — all landed in commits and PR threads and almost none reached the graph without the agent carrying them. They ask for the loop to SUBSCRIBE to reality rather than be fed it.

7. ARTIFACT CAPTURE IS THE LEAST-REWARDING STEP, SO IT IS THE ONE THAT GETS DEFERRED. Realization sat at zero while many PRs merged — consciously deferred, because modelling Artifacts is the most manual capture in the loop. Anything that makes registration near-free at merge time converts the graph's biggest systematic undercount into signal.

8. THE VERIFICATION DIGEST NAMES COUNTS, NOT SUBJECTS. graph_report gives a per-check count but not WHICH capability, so narrating what a check covers costs extra round trips.

9. TOOL-SURFACE SIZE. ~150 tools is workable behind deferred loading, but a client that eagerly loads schemas pays heavily; they suggest a curated core-subset server mode for small-context agents.

ALREADY SATISFIED — DROPPED PER ANTHONY'S TRIAGE RULE, NO NODE MINTED:

10. CONTRADICTORY SESSION-END MESSAGING (loop_status saying no nudge is installed while a Stop hook fires). ALREADY FOUND AND ALREADY FIXED: filed by a different project on 2026-08-09 and corrected in nudge.rs, which now reports what reflow2 LOOKED AT rather than asserting the world. Their report straddles their own mid-project upgrade. THIS IS THE THIRD PROJECT TO MEET IT, and the first two are why it is fixed.

=== WHAT THE REPORT SAYS REFLOW2 GETS RIGHT, recorded because praise is evidence too and this project keeps only its failures ===

served_by.stale and its derivation rather than version-literal comparison; honest computation over status fields ("computed from the thread, not from a status field", and the requirement-certainty split) which they say stops an agent laundering an assumption into a confirmed fact; refusal to default judgements (maturity_report declining to say where a design SHOULD be; loop_status refusing an unknown contributor id because "nothing is owed to you" is the most dangerous reply to a typo) — they call these the tool's epistemics and say the refusals TEACH them; the where-am-i structure, singling out the never-re-ask-in-different-words rule; acknowledged gaps carrying their full deferral reason, which made a months-long design legible in one call; and error messages that lead with "the design is not lost".

THEIR NET, verbatim and worth keeping intact: "the epistemic core — honest computation, refusal to default judgments, questions as first-class debt — is the product. Most of the friction above is the same shape: reality moves outside the graph, and the loop only sees what the agent hand-carries in. Cheapening that carry (asks, re-runs, artifacts, cross-graph facts) is where the remaining leverage is."

HONEST BOUND ON THIS NODE: one report, one agent, one project, and it is the agent's perspective rather than the human user's. Items 1 and 10 are independently corroborated by this repo's own measurements; items 2 through 9 are single-source, and recording them here is not evidence that anyone else needs them.
